data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 (grouping: 21 = 3×7 → 3×$2) and SRC_002 (unit rate: $2/7 per pencil → 21×$2/7) SHARE MECHANISM: both instantiate the same linear proportionality constant k = $2/7, differing only in whether the multiplier 3 is applied to the bundle-price ($2) or distributed across the individual pencil-rate ($2/7 × 7). The convergence at $6 is not coincidence but a necessary consequence of the shared constant. Refuted if the two derivations can be forced apart — e.g., if under a nonlinear regime the grouping path yields a different total than the per-unit path for the same quantity, breaking the shared-mechanism claim.
